segment.source: Renders formatted prose from the rich text editor — subheadings, lists, links and emphasis, held to a comfortable reading measure. Use it for: the body of an article, a legal or policy page, a long explanation, any passage an editor writes as continuous text. Prefer 'Lead Paragraph' for the standfirst that opens a piece, and 'Callout' for a passage that has to break out of the reading flow.
